mapper.insert: SELECT CLAIMS_SEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CLAIMS ( CLAIM_ID, CONTRACT_ID, CLAIM_TYPE, CLAIM_DATE, ACCIDENT_DATE, ACCIDENT_DESCRIPTION, BENEFICIARY_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT, BANK_NAME, BENEFICIARY_EMAIL, CLAIM_STATUS, COMPLETION_DATE, TOTAL_PAID_AMOUNT, DETAIL_FILE_PATH, RECEIPT_FILE_PATH, ETC_FILE_PATH, BENEFICIARY_POSTCODE, BENEFICIARY_ADDRESS, MEDICAL_BENEFITS, ACCIDENT_TYPE ) VALUES ( CLAIMS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{contract_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{claim_type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{claim_date, jdbcType=DATE}, #{accident_date, jdbcType=DATE}, #{accident_description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beneficiary_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bank_account, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bank_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beneficiary_email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{claim_status, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{completion_date, jdbcType=DATE}, #{total_paid_amount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{detail_file_path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{receipt_file_path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{etc_file_path, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beneficiary_postcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beneficiary_address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{medical_benefits, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accident_type, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.contract_id, ip.product_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.status FROM insurance_contracts c JOIN insurance_products ip ON c.product_id = ip.product_id JOIN customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.customer_id = #{customer_id} AND c.start_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -#{months})
ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC
SELECT * FROM CLAIMS ORDER BY claim_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CLAIMS SET contract_id = #{contract_id}, claim_type = #{claim_type}, claim_date = #{claim_date}, accident_date = #{accident_date}, accident_description = #{accident_description}, beneficiary_name = #{beneficiary_name}, bank_account = #{bank_account}, bank_name = #{bank_name}, beneficiary_email = #{beneficiary_email}, claim_status = #{claim_status}, completion_date = #{completion_date}, total_paid_amount = #{total_paid_amount}, detail_file_path = #{detail_file_path}, receipt_file_path = #{receipt_file_path}, etc_file_path = #{etc_file_path}, beneficiary_postcode = #{beneficiary_postcode}, beneficiary_address = #{beneficiary_address}, medical_benefits = #{medical_benefits}, accident_type = #{accident_type} WHERE claim_id = #{claim_id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.person_name AS name, p.personal_id AS personal_id, p.email AS email, p.phone_number AS phone_number FROM customers c JOIN persons p ON c.person_id = p.person_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customer_id}

SELECT c.claim_id, c.claim_date, c.accident_type, c.claim_status, p1.person_name AS insured_name, c.beneficiary_name FROM CLAIMS c JOIN INSURANCE_CONTRACTS ic ON c.contract_id = ic.contract_id JOIN CUSTOMERS cu ON ic.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN PERSONS p1 ON cu.person_id = p1.person_id WHERE cu.customer_id = #{customerId} AND c.claim_date >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -#{months}) ORDER BY c.claim_date DESC
